selection: minimum uncalibrated development soft cross entropy every 100 steps, including initialization
calibration: positive scalar temperature per primitive, fitted only on separate calibration cases
official_test: 400 cases, 2000 decisions; read only after selection and temperature fitting
limitations: Targets are public teacher distributions, not empirical outcome probabilities.
Training reserves 120 dev and 120 calibration cases from the 1200 source training cases.
The published phase4 starting checkpoint is not available; this run starts from the Qwen3 pretrained base.
